messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: user contributed code/doc packages
parts:
We're about to release 1.1.1, but I'm afraid we
have not yet gotten around to setting up a route for user
contributions. But we haven't forgotten you!

After 1.1.1, we're moving Stan from Google Code to GitHub.

At that point, we'll set up a contributed project site
and allow people to have commit access to it who want
to contribute models and/or code extensions for Stan.
Everyone can maintain their own licensing terms as long
as the licenses are compatible with Stan and/or RStan.

We'll then create a web page describing the contributions
and where to find them. We're not looking yet at doing
something as sophisticated or demanding on the build
side as CRAN (the R user-contributed package repository).

Daniel (who's volunteered to set it up) or I will post again
when it's ready for contributions.

- Bob
